steps.title: Диалект SQLite и проверка
steps.content:
## Курс LeetCode SQL

Задачи с [LeetCode](https://leetcode.com/problem-list/m8baczxh/) адаптированы под **SQLite 3** (sql.js в браузере). Модули `01`–`07` — учебный план [SQL 50](https://leetcode.com/studyplan/top-sql-50/); модули `08`–`12` — остальные бесплатные SQL-задачи LeetCode, сгруппированные по темам (JOIN/DML, агрегации и pivot, подзапросы и множества, окна и CTE, строки/regex и аналитика).

### Даты и время

| MySQL | SQLite |
|-------|--------|
| `DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m')` | `strftime('%Y-%m', d)` |
| `DATEDIFF(a, b)` | `julianday(a) - julianday(b)` |
| `DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)` | `DATE(d, '+1 day')` |

### Строки и regex

- `CONCAT(a, b)` → `a || b` или `printf('%s%s', a, b)`
- Оператор **`REGEXP`** в приложении — семантика **JavaScript** `RegExp` (регистрозависимый).
- `GLOB` — маска SQLite (`?`, `*`, `[a-z]`), возвращает 0/1.

### Проверка

- Сравнивается **последний** result set с колонками.
- **`checkColumnNames: true`** — имена столбцов как на LeetCode.
- **`orderMatters: true`** — порядок строк важен.
- **`checkQuery`** — для UPDATE/DELETE проверяется состояние таблиц после запроса.
- Задачи «функция» (Nth Salary): параметр в таблице **`params`** через `seed`.

### Ссылки

В каждой задаче — номер LeetCode и ссылка на оригинал.

- **`WHERE`**: `AND` / `OR`, не забывайте **`IS NULL`**.
- **`DISTINCT`**, **`ORDER BY`**, **`LIMIT`**.
- SQLite: `LENGTH(text)` вместо `CHAR_LENGTH`.

steps.title: JOIN и NULL в связях
steps.content:
## JOIN

- **`INNER JOIN`** — только совпадения.
- **`LEFT JOIN`** — все строки слева; нет пары → NULL справа.
- Сравнение дат: `DATE(col, "+1 day")` в SQLite.

## Агрегаты

content.description:
Средняя цена продажи каждого `product_id` за период (Units с `purchase_date` между «2019-01-01» и «2019-06-30»). Колонка `average_price`, округление 2 знака; нет продаж → NULL.

[LeetCode 1251](https://leetcode.com/problems/average-selling-price/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Products(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL, price INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Units(product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, purchase_date TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, AVG(price) AS average_price FROM Products GROUP BY product_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT p.product_id, ROUND(AVG(u.amount * p.price * 1.0) / NULLIF(SUM(u.amount), 0), 2) AS average_price FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Units u ON p.product_id = u.product_id AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN "2019-01-01" AND "2019-06-30" GROUP BY p.product_id;

steps.title: 1661. Average Time of Process per Machine

content.description:
Среднее время обработки (`processing_time`, округление **3** знака) для каждой `machine_id`: по каждой паре `(machine_id, process_id)` время = `end` − `start`, затем среднее по машине.

[LeetCode 1661](https://leetcode.com/problems/average-time-of-process-per-machine/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activity(machine_id INTEGER NOT NULL, process_id INTEGER NOT NULL, activity_type TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT machine_id, AVG(timestamp) AS processing_time FROM Activity GROUP BY machine_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT machine_id, ROUND(AVG(end_time - start_time), 3) AS processing_time FROM (SELECT machine_id, process_id, MAX(CASE WHEN activity_type = "start" THEN timestamp END) AS start_time, MAX(CASE WHEN activity_type = "end" THEN timestamp END) AS end_time FROM Activity GROUP BY machine_id, process_id) t GROUP BY machine_id;

content.description:
По `(month, country)`: `approved_count`, `approved_amount` (только state approved), `chargeback_count`, `chargeback_amount` (только chargeback). Месяц — `YYYY-MM` из `trans_date`.

[LeetCode 1193](https://leetcode.com/problems/monthly-transactions-i/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Transactions(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, country TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, trans_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT country, trans_date FROM Transactions;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT strftime("%Y-%m", trans_date) AS month, country,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN state = "approved" THEN 1 END) AS approved_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN state = "approved" THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_amount,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN state = "chargeback" THEN 1 END) AS chargeback_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN state = "chargeback" THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS chargeback_amount
FROM Transactions GROUP BY month, country ORDER BY month, country;

content.description:
Доля заказов первого заказа клиента (`order_number=1`), доставленных в **первый** день (`order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date`), в процентах `immediate_percentage` (2 знака).

[LeetCode 1174](https://leetcode.com/problems/immediate-food-delivery-ii/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Delivery(delivery_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, order_date TEXT NOT NULL, customer_pref_delivery_date TEXT NOT NULL, delivery_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT 100 AS immediate_percentage;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(SUM(order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS immediate_percentage FROM Delivery WHERE (customer_id, order_date) IN (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) FROM Delivery GROUP BY customer_id);

content.description:
Доля игроков, которые заходили **на следующий календарный день** после дня первого входа. Одна строка: `fraction` (округлить 2 знака).

[LeetCode 550](https://leetcode.com/problems/game-play-analysis-iv/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activity(player_id INTEGER NOT NULL, device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event_date TEXT NOT NULL, games_played INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT 0.0 AS fraction;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH first_login AS (SELECT player_id, MIN(event_date) AS fd FROM Activity GROUP BY player_id)
SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) FROM Activity a JOIN first_login f ON a.player_id = f.player_id WHERE a.event_date = DATE(f.fd, "+1 day")) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT player_id), 2) AS fraction FROM Activity;

content.description:
По каждому `query_name`: `quality` = avg(rating/position), `poor_query_percentage` = % rating < 3 (оба округлить 2 знака).

[LeetCode 1211](https://leetcode.com/problems/queries-quality-and-percentage/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Queries(query_name TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT query_name FROM Queries GROUP BY query_name;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT query_name,
  ROUND(AVG(rating * 1.0 / position), 2) AS quality,
  ROUND(SUM(rating < 3) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS poor_query_percentage
FROM Queries GROUP BY query_name;

steps.title: LEFT JOIN, анти-джойны и UPDATE
steps.content:
## Ещё раз про JOIN и DML

- **Анти-джойн**: `LEFT JOIN … WHERE right.id IS NULL` — «у левого нет пары».
- **`NOT IN` + подзапрос** — «нет ни одной связанной записи с условием».
- **`COALESCE(SUM(x), 0)`** — ноль вместо `NULL` при `LEFT JOIN`.
- **`UPDATE … SET col = CASE WHEN … END`** — DML-задачи проверяются по состоянию таблицы после запроса.

steps.title: Агрегаты, HAVING и разворот в колонки
steps.content:
## Агрегация и pivot

- `COUNT(DISTINCT x)` считает **разные** значения, `COUNT(x)` — непустые.
- `HAVING` фильтрует группы; агрегат можно сравнивать с агрегатом (`HAVING SUM(a) > 10000`).
- «Разворот» в колонки — `SUM(CASE WHEN month = … THEN revenue END)` по одной колонке на месяц.
- Целочисленное деление в SQLite: `SUM(x) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)`, иначе дробная часть теряется.

steps.title: Подзапросы, UNION и иерархии
steps.content:
## Подзапросы и множества

- Коррелированный подзапрос считает условие «для каждой строки» (например, нет сотрудника с большей зарплатой в отделе).
- **`UNION`** убирает дубликаты, **`UNION ALL`** — нет; обе ветви требуют одинаковых колонок.
- Дерево (`id`, `p_id`): `Root` — нет родителя, `Inner` — встречается как чей-то родитель, остальные — `Leaf`.
- **`LEAD(...) OVER (PARTITION BY … ORDER BY …)`** даёт следующую строку окна — удобно для пар «соседних» событий.

content.caption: UNION склеивает две выборки, UNION ALL сохраняет дубли

steps.title: Оконные функции, ранжирование и рекурсия
steps.content:
## Окна и CTE

- `ROW_NUMBER` / `RANK` / `DENSE_RANK` — нумерация внутри окна; `RANK` пропускает номера при ничьих, `DENSE_RANK` — нет.
- `LAG`/`LEAD` — предыдущая/следующая строка окна.
- «3+ подряд» — `id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id)` даёт одинаковую группу у последовательных строк.
- `WITH RECURSIVE` — иерархии: уровень = `уровень менеджера + 1`.
- Пара «стран-функция»: параметр N кладётся в таблицу `params` — `LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT n - 1 FROM params)`.

steps.content:
## Строки и аналитика

- **`REGEXP`** в приложении — **JavaScript**-регулярка (регистрозависимая): `^…$`, `[0-9]{4}`, `\b` (граница слова).
- Даты хранятся как `TEXT` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), сравниваются лексикографически; разница в днях — `julianday(a) - julianday(b)`.
- Неделя: `strftime('%Y-%W', d)`; время суток — `substr(ts, 12, 5)`.
- «Интервалы подряд» — приём `date(action_date, '-' || ROW_NUMBER() … || ' days')`: одинаковая метка у последовательных дней.
- `GLOB` проверяет по маске и возвращает 0/1: `x GLOB '[A-Za-z]'`, `x NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z]*'`.

content.description:
Преобразуйте каждое слово `content_text`: если слово начинается не с английской буквы — без изменений; если это 2+ части из английских букв через `-` — каждую часть с заглавной; иначе — первая буква заглавная, остальные строчные. Колонки `content_id`, `original_text`, `converted_text`.

[LeetCode 3374](https://leetcode.com/problems/first-letter-capitalization-ii/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE user_content(content_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, content_text TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT content_id, content_text AS original_text, UPPER(SUBSTR(content_text, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(content_text, 2)) AS converted_text FROM user_content ORDER BY content_id;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH RECURSIVE splitwords(content_id, idx, word, rest) AS (SELECT content_id, 1, CASE WHEN instr(content_text, ' ') = 0 THEN content_text ELSE substr(content_text, 1, instr(content_text, ' ') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(content_text, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(content_text, instr(content_text, ' ') + 1) END FROM user_content
UNION ALL SELECT content_id, idx + 1, CASE WHEN instr(rest, ' ') = 0 THEN rest ELSE substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ' ') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(rest, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(rest, instr(rest, ' ') + 1) END FROM splitwords WHERE rest <> ''),
parts(content_id, idx, part_idx, part, rest) AS (SELECT content_id, idx, 1, CASE WHEN instr(word, '-') = 0 THEN word ELSE substr(word, 1, instr(word, '-') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(word, '-') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(word, instr(word, '-') + 1) END FROM splitwords
UNION ALL SELECT content_id, idx, part_idx + 1, CASE WHEN instr(rest, '-') = 0 THEN rest ELSE substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, '-') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(rest, '-') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(rest, instr(rest, '-') + 1) END FROM parts WHERE rest <> ''),
hyphen(content_id, idx, part_idx, acc) AS (SELECT content_id, idx, 1, UPPER(SUBSTR(part, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(part, 2)) FROM parts WHERE part_idx = 1
UNION ALL SELECT p.content_id, p.idx, p.part_idx, h.acc || '-' || UPPER(SUBSTR(p.part, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(p.part, 2)) FROM hyphen h JOIN parts p ON p.content_id = h.content_id AND p.idx = h.idx AND p.part_idx = h.part_idx + 1),
wordinfo AS (SELECT w.content_id, w.idx, w.word, COUNT(p.part_idx) AS part_count, MAX(CASE WHEN p.part_idx = 1 AND SUBSTR(p.part, 1, 1) GLOB '[A-Za-z]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS starts_letter, MIN(CASE WHEN p.part <> '' AND p.part NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z]*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_letters FROM splitwords w JOIN parts p ON p.content_id = w.content_id AND p.idx = w.idx GROUP BY w.content_id, w.idx),
converted AS (SELECT content_id, idx, CASE WHEN starts_letter = 0 THEN word WHEN all_letters = 1 AND part_count >= 2 THEN (SELECT acc FROM hyphen h WHERE h.content_id = wordinfo.content_id AND h.idx = wordinfo.idx ORDER BY h.part_idx DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(word, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(word, 2)) END AS conv FROM wordinfo),
built(content_id, idx, out) AS (SELECT content_id, idx, conv FROM converted WHERE idx = 1
UNION ALL SELECT b.content_id, c.idx, b.out || ' ' || c.conv FROM built b JOIN converted c ON c.content_id = b.content_id AND c.idx = b.idx + 1)
SELECT uc.content_id, uc.content_text AS original_text, COALESCE((SELECT out FROM built b WHERE b.content_id = uc.content_id ORDER BY b.idx DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS converted_text FROM user_content uc ORDER BY uc.content_id;

steps.title: 3617. Find Students with Study Spiral Pattern

content.description:
Студенты, которые изучают ≥ 3 разных предмета повторяющимся циклом (минимум 2 полных цикла, ≥ 6 сессий), причём все соседние сессии идут без разрыва больше 2 дней. Колонки `student_id`, `student_name`, `major`, `cycle_length`, `total_study_hours`. Сортировка: `cycle_length` убыв., часы убыв.

[LeetCode 3617](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-students-with-study-spiral-pattern/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE students(student_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_name TEXT NOT NULL, major TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE study_sessions(session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, session_date TEXT NOT NULL, hours_studied REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, s.major, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.subject) AS cycle_length, SUM(ss.hours_studied) AS total_study_hours FROM students s JOIN study_sessions ss ON ss.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ss.subject) >= 3 ORDER BY cycle_length DESC, total_study_hours DESC;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH ranked AS (SELECT student_id, session_id, session_date, subject, hours_studied, julianday(session_date) - julianday(LAG(session_date) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY session_date, session_id)) AS gap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY session_date, session_id) AS idx FROM study_sessions),
contig AS (SELECT student_id FROM ranked GROUP BY student_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN gap > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0),
stats AS (SELECT r.student_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject) AS k FROM ranked r JOIN contig c ON c.student_id = r.student_id GROUP BY r.student_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject) >= 3 AND COUNT(*) >= 2 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject) AND COUNT(*) % COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject) = 0),
good AS (SELECT st.student_id, st.k FROM stats st WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ranked cur JOIN ranked cyc ON cyc.student_id = cur.student_id AND cyc.idx = ((cur.idx - 1) % st.k) + 1 WHERE cur.student_id = st.student_id AND cur.subject <> cyc.subject))
SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, s.major, g.k AS cycle_length, ROUND((SELECT SUM(r.hours_studied) FROM ranked r WHERE r.student_id = g.student_id), 2) AS total_study_hours FROM good g JOIN students s ON s.student_id = g.student_id ORDER BY cycle_length DESC, total_study_hours DESC;

WITH single AS (SELECT user_id, action_date, action FROM activity WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity a2 WHERE a2.user_id = activity.user_id AND a2.action_date = activity.action_date) = 1),
grp AS (SELECT user_id, action, action_date, date(action_date, '-' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, action ORDER BY action_date) || ' days') AS g FROM single),
streaks AS (SELECT user_id, action, COUNT(*) AS streak_length, MIN(action_date) AS start_date, MAX(action_date) AS end_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM grp GROUP BY user_id, action, g HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5)
SELECT user_id, action, streak_length, start_date, end_date FROM streaks WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY streak_length DESC, user_id;
